Relics can be discovered and collected by fleets, and they generate Science when unassigned. Spend Relics to: • Create a temple on a planet, removing the FIDS malus • Empower Heroes • Grant potent new faction traits

The Empire begins with three long-dormant, completed colonies safely hidden between the vicinity of the homeworld and the galactic core. These can be awakened by fleets or other new colonies.

Systems marked as Slumbering Ruins can be awakened to recover resources, population, and system upgrades. To awaken a Ruin, send a fleet to an uncolonized system and use the Awaken action of the Fleet, or build the related System Improvement on a conquered system.
Beware that other Empires possessing this trait can also Awaken ruins, even those belonging to you.
Each faction with this trait will have three of these Ruins scattered across non-Capitol systems.
Ruins you have not yet discovered will be revealed when you receive the first step of your faction quest.

This Empire is a steadfast and influential patron of the Academy and its agenda, with an eternal reservoir of good will and the bureaucratic experience and dedication to make extravagant donations of entire systems.

This empire will focus on expansion and exerting its influence.
Declaring a Crusade upon another Empire allows all other Empires to attack those ships and systems, and lasts until they nullify it through negotiation with the Academy.

Declaring the Ban upon another Empire prevents that Empire from being able to donate any more to the Academy for 20 turns (scaling with Game Speed). Additional uses can be obtained through Academy Diplomacy.

Isolated monasteries, abbeys, and research villages in the frozen wastes allow the Empire to safely sequester its most dedicated scientists away from the devout, in a naturally research-friendly environment.

Faith in the Lost and the field of natural philosophy have protected the former from ignorance and the latter from heresy since the beginning; by building lab facilities into our religious centers, clerical researchers can work efficiently and in peace.

A popular initiative for lifetime education in the gifts of the Lost, the Foundation organizes free exhibitions and classes around the Relics of the Lost, combining community benefit with immense crowdsourced insight from the faithful.

The sublime influence of the Lost and the cruelty of the Endless who slew them can be found throughout the galaxies anomalies, making dedicated historical and scientific faculty an important institution for the Nakalim.

Regardless of technological ease, flight will always be a miracle which excites the senses and enflames the soul. So it is with flying cities, which can inspire the faithful to new and incredible miracles of technology within the rich chemistry and physics playgrounds which are gas giants.

While the rest of the system will not be neglected, incorporating our defenses and training programs into historical and holy sites will reinforce good health and training regimens as a communal and spiritual obligation.

By weaponizing planets' magnetic fields, or in some cases applying charge to their gravity wells, plasma bombs can be protected from atmospheric scatter on the way down, and plasma mines can avoid leaking away their energy at less cost or for longer periods on the ground.

While explosive drones have been deployed for millennia, Universal Aerodynamics allow greater industry of scale to be applied to their manufacture, as the same production lines can be used across all environments; the same drones quickly become a staple of both organized bombardment campaigns and colonial defense groups.

New geographical scanning technology allows territory to be quickly copied and simulated in entertainment systems, providing accuracy to non-fiction, instant relatability to fiction, and immense value to casual wargames. As a result, citizens familiarize themselves with every defensive trick in the book unique to the simulated area, whether to defend their homes or better infiltrate someone else's.
